project.name: SentinelOps
project.objective: Build a local-first incident-response system that runs reproducible failures against a disposable application, investigates evidence, and performs only human-approved remediation while remaining ready for future external integrations.
constraints: Local Docker Compose is the first supported runtime.
Product code must not target real production infrastructure in the initial release.
non_goals: External SaaS, observability, incident-management, and cloud connectors in the initial release.
project.trust_boundary: local developer machine and disposable Docker environment

lifecycle.next_action: Create requirement-linked implementation tasks with executable gates, then run genesis plan check.

invariants.text: No product implementation code may be written until the current Genesis specification and plan are explicitly approved by the human.
invariants.source: User instruction in this Codex chat on 2026-11-23

decisions.title: Local-first validation
decisions.text: Build and prove the complete incident workflow against a disposable Docker Compose application before adding external project connectors.
decisions.source: User discussion in this Codex chat on 2026-11-23

decisions.title: Human-approved remediation
decisions.text: All state-changing remediation is allowlisted, scoped to the active incident, and blocked until a human explicitly approves it.
decisions.source: User discussion in this Codex chat on 2026-11-23

decisions.title: Incremental incident catalog
decisions.text: Implement the faulty payments deployment first, then database connection exhaustion, then Redis unavailability; run scenarios sequentially and reset between them.
decisions.source: User discussion in this Codex chat on 2026-11-23

decisions.title: Connector-ready without plugin framework
decisions.text: Keep local telemetry, runtime, deployment, and remediation access behind simple module boundaries. Do not build dynamic plugins or external adapters until the local workflow is proven.
decisions.source: Genesis Ponytail full and user discussion in this Codex chat on 2026-11-23

decisions.title: Separate failure scenarios from incidents
decisions.text: Use SCN-* for deliberately injected local failure scenarios and reserve INC-* for incident records SentinelOps creates from accepted alerts.
decisions.source: User clarification in Codex chat on 2026-11-24

decisions.title: Alert-driven local incident creation
decisions.text: For the local MVP, Prometheus evaluates versioned metric rules, Alertmanager posts firing and resolved notifications to the SentinelOps webhook, and SentinelOps validates and deduplicates alerts before creating or updating an incident.
decisions.source: User clarification in Codex chat on 2026-11-24

decisions.title: Incremental failure-scenario catalog
decisions.text: Implement SCN-001 faulty payments deployment first, then SCN-002 database connection exhaustion, then SCN-003 Redis unavailability; run scenarios sequentially and reset between them.
decisions.source: Revised SentinelOps terminology approved in Codex chat on 2026-11-24
